head: Flipcorder turns your day into one retro camcorder tape
dek: Flipcorder records 20-second clips that land on a dated 30-minute "cassette" for the day, then plays them back as one unedited home movie. It was #6 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: The listing says one price, paid once: no subscription, no watermark, no ads. It costs $4.99, by Lotus Apps, and needs iOS 26.
means: If you like keeping a video diary, it gives you one short tape per day without editing.
todo: Find Flipcorder in the App Store; it needs iOS 26 or later.
